manual_review_reason: The public form accepts one WAV or MP3 at 44.1 or 48 kHz and 16-bit stereo through an under-10MB upload or downloadable link, but it contains a dynamic arithmetic human-verification challenge and requires a rights affirmation and authorization to broadcast. International eligibility, explicit-content rules, genre intake, release timing and AI-origin policy are not published. A human must select one suitable MarcsMusic track, inspect the exact audio master and metadata, verify rights, choose upload or link delivery, answer the locality question accurately, complete the human-verification challenge personally, recheck the live form and submit manually.
